nodes.name: Atria Trigger
nodes.notes: Feed source: Create New Feed - creates and starts the ERC-20 feed on activation, pauses it on deactivation. Emits {contract, from, to, rawAmount, network, txHash}; nothing else in this workflow reads the raw block.

nodes.name: Whale Gate
nodes.notes: Threshold gate placed BEFORE enrichment: keeps >= $100k, and keeps every event it could not value - an event is never dismissed by a number we failed to compute.

nodes.name: Append row in sheet
nodes.notes: Appends one row per whale transfer to Whale transfers - the ledger both the hourly digest and the weekly partitioning read.

nodes.name: Unique Contracts
nodes.notes: The one network map of this workflow: Atria network id → CoinGecko platform and GoPlus chain. Unmapped networks never leave the workflow - they stay unvaluable rather than failing.

nodes.name: Token Price & Meta (CoinGecko)
nodes.notes: One request per unique token in the batch: id, symbol, decimals and USD price. Decimals are what turn rawAmount into a human amount.

nodes.name: Amount Resolve
nodes.notes: Divides rawAmount by 10 ** decimals from the CoinGecko branch above (a leaf read by name) and stamps usdValue. Keeps pairedItem, so downstream item indices stay the trigger's.

nodes.name: Unique Whale Contracts
nodes.notes: GoPlus dedup: every whale contract in the batch collapses into one token_security request per chain (30 addresses per call, the free-tier cap).

nodes.name: Token Safety (GoPlus)
nodes.notes: Token security for a whole chain in one call. A skip item is sent when there is nothing to ask, so an empty batch cannot stall the branch.

nodes.name: Safety Join (Events + GoPlus)
nodes.notes: Joins whale events with GoPlus answers. Items are told apart by SHAPE, not by source node - only one input carries rawAmount.

nodes.name: Safety Resolve
nodes.notes: Attaches GoPlus flags (honeypot, buy/sell tax, owner change) to each event. Pricing already happened upstream in Amount Resolve.

nodes.name: GoPlus Per Chain
nodes.notes: Pairs each GoPlus request with its answer by position, which is how Safety Resolve can tell requests from responses.

nodes.name: Known Wallets (Sheets)
nodes.notes: Read-only leaf: the Wallets tab maps address → label. Terminal by design and read by name below, so an empty tab cannot stall the branch.

nodes.name: Known Wallet Labels
nodes.notes: Adds counterparty labels (exchange, treasury, whale) to each event before it is written to the ledger.

parameters.text: ={{ 'Write a 5-bullet hourly whale-watch digest from these ledger rows (most important flow first, mention labels and USD totals). Reply with STRICT JSON only, no prose, no code fences: {"headline": "optional, max 60 characters", "bullets": ["3 to 5 lines, max 120 characters each"]}. Inside the strings write plain text only: no * or _ or backtick markers, no < > & characters, no leading dash, amounts as $11,982. ' + JSON.stringify($json) }}

options.systemMessage: You are summarizing on-chain whale flows for a trading desk chat channel. Be terse, factual, no hedging. Reply with a single JSON object and nothing else.

nodes.name: Digest Writer (AI Agent)
nodes.notes: Writes the digest. Asked for STRICT JSON so the render step can repair it, with continueRegularOutput so a provider error still yields a digest.

nodes.name: Google Gemini Chat Model
nodes.notes: Language model behind the digest agent (temperature 0.3).

nodes.name: Telegram Digest
nodes.notes: Posts the hourly digest. parse_mode is HTML - n8n's default Markdown rejects the bare * the model emits with 400 can't parse entities.

nodes.name: Hourly Digest Trigger
nodes.notes: Every hour on the hour; the digest reads the ledger rather than re-consuming events, so it survives a dropped delivery.

nodes.name: Read Ledger Rows
nodes.notes: Full read of Whale transfers. Sheets has no filter we can push down, so the window is applied in memory by the next node.

nodes.name: Last Hour Events
nodes.notes: Collapses the whole read into ONE summary item: counts, top flows, and the severity bands p1/p2/p3 the Telegram template prints. Publishes capturedAt, the age key the weekly branch sorts on.

nodes.name: Digest Render
nodes.notes: Turns the model's reply into one Telegram-safe message: unwraps code fences, escapes & < >, converts markdown bullets. Everything the model can get wrong is handled here, not in a {{ }} template.

nodes.name: Weekly Partitioning Trigger
nodes.notes: Weekly. Archives ledger rows older than 7 days, then prunes them.

nodes.name: Read Ledger (Weekly)
nodes.notes: Full read of the same tab the hourly digest reads - not just the rows to archive.

nodes.name: Partition Ledger Rows
nodes.notes: Age split only, writes nothing. Rows younger than the cutoff wait for next week.

nodes.name: Archive Old Rows
nodes.notes: Append-only into "Whale transfers archive" (create it once, same header row as the ledger). This is the point of no return: the delete below only runs if this worked.

nodes.name: Plan Prune Range
nodes.notes: Turns the split into one sheet range. No old rows means no item, so no delete.

nodes.name: Prune Ledger Rows
nodes.notes: Deletes the whole range in one call, never retried. Safe only because the ledger is append-only.

parameters.content:
## Weekly partitioning

Every Sunday 04:15: rows older than **7 days** are appended to **Whale transfers archive**, only then deleted from **Whale transfers**. Create that tab once, with the same header row.
If the archive write fails, the delete never runs; the delete is never retried.

## What this does

Your Atria feed watches the chain and delivers every matching ERC-20 transfer to n8n. This workflow turns those events into a priced, safety-checked, labelled ledger in Google Sheets, and posts an hourly whale digest to your Telegram chat. A weekly job keeps the ledger small.

Only transfers worth $100,000 or more are kept, and only the ones the workflow managed to put a USD price on.

## How it works

- **Atria Trigger**: creates and starts its own ERC-20 Atria feed when you activate the workflow, and delivers the largest transfer of each block.
- **Token Price & Meta (CoinGecko)**: looks each token market price.
- **Amount Resolve**: turns the raw token amount into USD value.
- **USD Value Filter and Whale Gate**: keep only the transfers big enough to be worth alerting on.
- **Token Safety (GoPlus) and Safety Resolve**: mark the risky tokens, such as honeypots and contracts with a changeable owner.
- **Known Wallets (Sheets) and Known Wallet Labels**: put a name on the sender and the receiver when you have labelled that address before.
- **Hourly digest**: reads the ledger back, summarises the last hour, lets Gemini analyze collected transfers, and posts them to Telegram.
- **Weekly partitioning**: moves rows older than a week into an archive tab, then deletes them from the ledger.

## Setup

1. **Install and import.** Add the `n8n-nodes-atria` community node to your n8n instance, then import this workflow.
2. **Connect Atria.** In the Atria dashboard (Account → API Keys) create an API key with the scopes `feeds.read`, `feeds.manage`, `outputs.read`, `outputs.manage`, and store it in n8n as an Atria API credential (base URL `https://atria.pulsy.app/api`).
3. **Create one spreadsheet with three tabs:** `Whale transfers` for the ledger, `Wallets` with two columns `address,label` for your known addresses, and `Whale transfers archive` with the same header as the ledger. The columns the workflow fills are listed on the *Append row in sheet* node.
4. **Paste the spreadsheet ID** into the six `REPLACE_WITH_SPREADSHEET_ID` fields, and select your Google Sheets credential in the same six nodes.
5. **Connect Telegram.** Add a Telegram credential and put your chat id into `REPLACE_WITH_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID`.
6. **Connect Gemini.** Add a Google Gemini credential to the chat-model node.

### Tuning it

- Whale floor: `WHALE_MIN_USD` in Whale Gate.
- Ledger retention: `RETAIN_DAYS` in Partition Ledger Rows.
- Notification rate: Once per Hour.

## Requirements

- An Atria account and an API key.
- A Google account for the ledger.
- A Telegram bot and the chat id to post to.
- A Gemini API key for the digest agent.

## Capture & valuation
The trigger decodes `Transfer` logs and emits the largest ERC-20 transfer per block. CoinGecko (branch above) prices each token once - decimals + USD - Amount Resolve converts `rawAmount`, and Whale Gate drops sub-$100k events before paid enrichment.

## Safety & labelling
Whale events get GoPlus security flags (honeypot, mintable, owner-change) in one batched call per chain, joined back by chain + address. The Wallets tab adds exchange/treasury labels, then each event is written to the ledger.

## Hourly digest
Re-reads the ledger, not the chain: last hour's rows collapse into one summary (counts, USD bands, top flows), Gemini writes five bullets, Digest Render makes it Telegram-safe, the bot posts. A quiet hour stays silent.

nodes.name: USD Value Filter1
nodes.notes: Drops transfers Amount Resolve could not price (usdValue is null) before the whale gate, so unpriced events never reach GoPlus/Sheets or the ledger. This is the only node that discards an event for a missing USD value - Whale Gate below keeps everything it can price.
